items.evidence: From a stopped engine: python work/tools/gate.py run --seed 1 --ticks 1 --settings ./s1 printed {"tick":1,"screen":"title","menu_index":0,"language":"en","volume":5,"texts":["Hold the gate","Start","Settings","Quit"],"score":0,"wave":1,"gate_health":5,"guard_y":6,"walkers":[],"bolts":[]}, which has every key the brief asks for.
--frame wrote 12 PNGs (title, settings, play, paused, lost, won, wave 2); the IHDR of each says 800x480, and I opened them all.
Title texts were [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]. down@0, enter@2 gave screen settings. enter@0 then 400 ticks gave play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5.
From volume 5, 7x right gave volume 10 (it stopped at 10). In the next run, 12x left from 10 gave volume 0 (it stopped at 0).

In Settings, down plus right changed texts to [Ajustes, Volumen: 0, Idioma: Español, Volver]. Title was then [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir], play was [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Vida de la puerta: 5], and paused added [En pausa, Continuar, Pantalla de título]. No English was left and nothing was missing, in both the state and the frames.

Run 1 on ./sA set volume to 10, and run 2 on ./sA started at 10. Run 2 set volume 0 and Spanish, and run 3 on ./sA started with es and volume 0. A fresh folder (./s1, ./sB) started with volume 5 and en.
Holding up for 40 ticks moved guard_y from 6 to 10, and 30 ticks moved it to 9 (6 u/s). Holding down for 149 ticks stopped at guard_y 0, and holding up for 149 ticks stopped at 12.

In lane y=9, I held shoot from tick 31 and read the state at tick 160. There were 3 bolts at x 15.3, 9.7 and 4.1, spaced 5.6 = 24 ticks x 14/60. The 3 earlier bolts had passed x=20 and were gone, as 14 u/s predicts.

Seed 1 at tick 400: 5 walkers at x 10.025, 12.275, 14.525, 16.775, 19.025 (2.25 apart = 90 ticks at 1.5 u/s) in lanes 10, 8, 4, 2, 10. These match 1.5 u/s exactly, and after 810 ticks no 6th walker had appeared.

With the guard at y=10 and shoot held from tick 41: at tick 120 the lane-10 walker had health 1. At tick 140 it was gone, score was 10, and the lane-8 walker was untouched. Bolts fired at y=9 left the walkers in lanes 10 and 8 at health 2 and flew past them.

With no input: at tick 810 the first walker was gone and gate_health was 4. At tick 1200 the screen was lost, gate_health 0, texts [You lost, Final score: 0, Enter: title], and lost.png shows the same.

I killed the 2 lane-10 walkers and let the other 3 through. The last one left at the step taking tick 1070 to 1071. At tick 1251 the state was still wave 1 with no walkers; at tick 1252 it was wave 2 with 1 walker (about 3 s). At tick 1793 there were 7 walkers and texts said 'Wave 2 of 5', also in wave2.png; in Spanish, 'Oleada 1 de 5'.

I made a 145-input script with the game's bot (tools/autoplay.py) and replayed it with gate.py --ticks 5420. It ended on screen won, score 450, gate 5, texts [You won, Final score: 450, Enter: title]. Adding enter@5425 gave screen title.

escape@200 then read at tick 400: screen paused, walkers at x 15.025, 17.275, 19.525 (frozen at the tick-200 state), and up held while paused did not move the guard. escape@200 plus enter@300 gave a state at tick 400 identical to an unpaused run at tick 299. escape, down, enter gave screen title.
Two runs with seed 1, 1793 ticks and the same script printed byte-identical output (cmp). Seed 2 at tick 400 put walkers in lanes 2, 6, 4, 10, 2, where seed 1 gave 10, 8, 4, 2, 10.

In play1/hit140/wave2.png the frame is 40 px per unit with y going up. The gate is a bar at x=0. The guard is at (2, guard_y). Walkers, for example (10.025, 10), are at px (401, 80), and bolts at x 13.9/8.3/2.7 are at px 556/332/108. The HUD shows Score, Wave n of 5 and Gate health, and these match the state.

title.png shows '> Start <'. settings_en.png shows '> Volume: 10 <'. settings_es.png shows Ajustes with '> Idioma: Español <'. title_es.png shows Defiende la puerta with '> Empezar <'. paused_es.png shows '> Continuar <'.

The strings are in modules/work/strings/en.json and es.json, one table per language. lib.rs only looks up keys (screen_texts/text). README 'Add a language' gives steps to copy the table, add a LOCALES line and add a LANGS entry.
README has a 'How to play' key table and the exact gate.py run / --frame commands. Those commands worked as written from a stopped engine; each run started, loaded and stopped the engine itself.

defects: After leaving a run (pause -> Title, or Enter on won), the state still reports the old walkers/bolts on the title screen (e.g. 3 walkers on title after pause->Title; 2 bolts on title after won).
On the won screen the leftover bolts stay frozen in the state and are drawn in the frame (won.png).
Volume/language are saved only by the headless runner (settings.json written by tools/gate.py); a game played in the engine's window starts with defaults each time (README admits it).
Quit on the title screen does nothing.
Wave 2's first walker appears 181 ticks after the last walker of wave 1 is gone (one tick over 3 s); negligible.
